title: Katana+
description: simple mod add katanas, bonsai, and ninja armor
body:
# Katanas+

Katanas+ adds a set of colored katanas that double as shields, decorative bonsai trees, and a stealthy ninja armor set. Built for **NeoForge 1.21.1**.

## ⚔️ Katanas

Seven dye-colored katanas — **Dark, Red, Orange, Blue, Purple, Yellow, Green**.

- Stats of a netherite sword** — same damage, attack speed and durability.
- Block like a shield** — hold **right-click** to raise the katana in front of you. It blocks incoming frontal damage exactly like a vanilla shield (first-person guard pose included).
- No block penalty** — unlike a shield, blocking does **not** drain the katana's durability.



🌳 Decorative Bonsai
